text.ms:
1. (1) Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah Isyarat Lalu

Lintas (Saiz, Warna dan Jenis) (Pindaan) 2012.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 23 September 2012.

Pindaan Jadual

2. Kaedah-Kaedah Isyarat Lalu Lintas (Saiz, Warna dan Jenis) 1959 [L.N. 167/1959]

dipinda dalam Jadual—

(a) dalam Bahagian I, di bawah tajuk "DANGER SIGNS", dengan memasukkan

selepas isyarat lalu lintas No. 13W isyarat lalu lintas yang berikut:

(b) dalam Bahagian VI, di bawah tajuk "PLACING AND HEIGHT OF ROAD

SIGNS", di bawah kepala "PART I DANGER SIGNS", dengan memasukkan

selepas perenggan (4), perenggan yang berikut:

"; dan

 "(5) Traffic sign No. 13X shall be placed between fifty to five hundred

metres from the location of the detector system for a static camera at the

signalized junction.

 (6) Traffic sign No. 13Xa shall be placed between two to three

kilometres from the location of—

(a) the detector system for a static camera; or

(b) mobile camera operation,

as the case may be.

(7) The detector system referred to in paragraphs (5) and (6) refers to

the detector system as specified in the Road Transport (Camera-Recorded

Offences) Rules 2012 [P.U. (A) 309/2012].".

Dibuat 21 September 2012

[KP/PUU/0.440/W/BD/9; PN(PU2)460/LXVII]

 DATO' SERI KONG CHO HA

 Menteri Pengangkutan
